name: AI SDK
what: Vercel's provider-agnostic TypeScript toolkit for building AI apps and agents, with UI hooks for Next.js, React, Svelte, Vue and Angular. One API covers OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and many more providers, either through Vercel AI Gateway (the default) or each provider's own package. Apache-2.0.
who: Web developers adding chat, streaming or agent features to a JavaScript or TypeScript app.

setup.text: To call providers directly instead of through AI Gateway, add their packages:
